say:0:1013201001:0.text: The biggest book I saw in the village was "Dura's Miracles".
say:0:1013201001:0.source_cn: 我从小生长在村子里。见过字最多的一本书，是圣堂派发的《...

say:1:1013201002:0.text: But when I first visited the Evergreen Conservatory's camp...
say:1:1013201002:0.source_cn: 直到第一次进冬青学会的营地，看到那么多书，那么多复杂的...

say:2:1013201003:0.text: Seeing their books and intricate instruments felt like a dream.

say:0:1013202001:0.text: And the people at the camp were quite reasonable!
say:0:1013202001:0.source_cn: 起初还担心他们看不起我，熟了后才发现，那群人都蛮讲道理的！

say:1:1013202002:0.text: Making friends with them wasn't that hard after all!
say:1:1013202002:0.source_cn: 人和人成为朋友，根本没那么复杂嘛！

say:0:1013203001:0.text: What do I do now? Fay's disappeared again...
say:0:1013203001:0.source_cn: 这怎么办啊？菲又不见了……

say:1:1013203002:0.text: Where could she have gone? Oh, is that Marilee?
say:1:1013203002:0.source_cn: 去哪找她啊？诶！是梅瑞特吗？

say:3:1013204001:1.text: Marilee, do you know where Fay went?
say:3:1013204001:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特，你有菲的消息吗？

say:4:1013204002:1.source_cn: 她不在营地？又跑出去了？

say:5:1013204003:1.source_cn: 原来你还不知道。菲失踪了！

say:6:1013204004:1.text: I remember she'd sneak out occasionally... but she'd never go too far.
say:6:1013204004:1.source_cn: 我记得她偶尔会溜出去……可是从不会走得太远！

say:7:1013204005:1.text: Oh no, if we lose her, someone will be upset... But at a time like this, who should we ask to find her?
say:7:1013204005:1.source_cn: 呜哇，要是弄丢了那位，有人会生气的……可这种时候，该拜...

say:8:1013204006:1.text: I've taken her around the camp's surroundings a few times; she shouldn't have gotten lost easily.
say:8:1013204006:1.source_cn: 营地周边，我带她走过几次，应该不太可能是迷路。

say:9:1013204007:1.text: Could she... be in danger? What if she encountered some powerful Hypogean or golem? She wouldn't be able to handle it alone!
say:9:1013204007:1.source_cn: 难道……遇到危险了？要是遭遇什么厉害的魔物、魔偶，她一...

say:12:1013204008:0.text: Seems like now isn't the best time for us to ask about the golems.
say:12:1013204008:0.source_cn: 看来现在，不是我们询问魔偶之事的好时机。

say:15:1013204009:1.text: Of course! A girl has gone missing, we gotta help find her!
say:15:1013204009:1.source_cn: 当然！有个女孩子失踪了，我们得帮忙去找才行！

say:16:1013204010:1.text: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
say:16:1013204010:1.male: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
say:16:1013204010:1.female: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?

choice_prompt:17:1013204010.text: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
choice_prompt:17:1013204010.source_cn: 盲目地找不是办法——<style=stress><player_name></style>大人，你觉得该怎么找？
choice_prompt:17:1013204010.male: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?
choice_prompt:17:1013204010.female: Searching blindly would take too much time. <style="stress"><player_name></style>, what do you think is the best way to find her?

say:20:1013204011:2.text: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:20:1013204011:2.source_cn: 菲说过，强大的魔法师无所不能！你肯定能想出办法……吧？
say:20:1013204011:2.male: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:20:1013204011:2.female: Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?

say:23:1013204013:1.text: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!
say:23:1013204013:1.source_cn: 好可怕的洞察力……这么快就看出了主人的不凡！
say:23:1013204013:1.male: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!
say:23:1013204013:1.female: Agreed! Magister is definitely the strongest around here, we'll find Fay in no time!

say:24:1013204014:1.text: Let's go back to where Fay was last seen and follow any clues or traces to figure out which direction she might have disappeared in.
say:24:1013204014:1.source_cn: 主人常用的方法——回到发现菲失踪的地点，然后追踪痕迹，...
say:24:1013204014:1.male: Let's go back to where Fay was last seen and follow any clues or traces to figure out which direction she might have disappeared in.
say:24:1013204014:1.female: Let's go back to where Fay was last seen and follow any clues or traces to figure out which direction she might have disappeared in.

say:27:1013204015:1.text: Let's go. The sooner we pinpoint that girl's location, the safer she'll be.
say:27:1013204015:1.source_cn: 听起来很可靠嘛？走吧，能早一点确定那女孩的位置，她就多...
say:27:1013204015:1.male: Let's go. The sooner we pinpoint that girl's location, the safer she'll be.
say:27:1013204015:1.female: Let's go. The sooner we pinpoint that girl's location, the safer she'll be.

say:30:1013204016:1.text: May Dura watch over her... Please protect that girl!
say:30:1013204016:1.source_cn: 艾雅在上……千万保佑那女孩！

say:32:1013204012:3.text: Because you're a great magister! Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:32:1013204012:3.source_cn: 因为你是大魔法师！菲对我说过，强大的魔法师无所不能，所...
say:32:1013204012:3.male: Because you're a great magister! Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?
say:32:1013204012:3.female: Because you're a great magister! Fay told me powerful magisters can do anything! You can definitely come up with something... right?

say:2:1013205001:3.text: Faride, have you seen Fay around?

say:3:1013205002:1.text: Let me think... Oh, I remember now. She was engrossed in writing notes about gemstone research.
say:3:1013205002:1.source_cn: 让我回忆一下……啊，我想到了，菲那时在写着宝石研究手记。

say:4:1013205003:1.text: Suddenly, she reacted to something unusual, exclaimed, and hurriedly dashed out. She never came back...
say:4:1013205003:1.source_cn: 然后突然大喊着，好奇怪的气息，就慌忙跑了出去。再也没回...

say:3:1013206001:0.text: What do we do? Could she be in danger?
say:3:1013206001:0.source_cn: 怎么办，怎么办？她不会遇到什么危险吧？

say:4:1013206002:1.text: Marilee, could you search for her? Ugh... I should have stayed by her side.
say:4:1013206002:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特，你能去找找她吗？唉……早知道我就陪着她了。

choice_prompt:5:1013206002.text: Marilee, could you search for her? Ugh... I should have stayed by her side.
choice_prompt:5:1013206002.source_cn: 梅瑞特，你能去找找她吗？唉……早知道我就陪着她了。

say:6:1013206003:1.text: I gotta say, Fay has a remarkable sensitivity when it comes to gemstones... It's quite admirable.
say:6:1013206003:1.source_cn: 非要说的话，菲对宝石有一定的感应能力，这还挺令人羡慕的……

say:8:1013206004:1.text: Miss, let's stick to the topic.
say:8:1013206004:1.source_cn: 这位学者小姐，不要跑题。

say:9:1013206005:1.text: Ah, my apologies! Fay's unexpected disappearances usually revolve around exploring gemstones.
say:9:1013206005:1.source_cn: 啊，抱歉！菲对宝石很感兴趣，突然的消失基本都跟宝石探查有关。

say:1:1013207001:3.source_cn: 或许，你有见过一个随处乱跑的菲小姐？

say:2:1013207002:0.text: I did catch sight of her as I was heading back to camp, and she greeted me.
say:2:1013207002:0.source_cn: 我在返回营地的时候确实见过她，她还跟我打了个招呼。

choice_prompt:3:1013207002.text: I did catch sight of her as I was heading back to camp, and she greeted me.
choice_prompt:3:1013207002.source_cn: 我在返回营地的时候确实见过她，她还跟我打了个招呼。

say:4:1013207003:2.text: I remember clearly that she went in the opposite direction of the Moon Temple. I found it a bit perplexing at the time...
say:4:1013207003:2.source_cn: 我记得很清楚，她去的方向跟月神遗殿的方向相反，我当时还...

say:6:1013207004:1.text: Huh? That's the way we came from, but we didn't pass her...
say:6:1013207004:1.source_cn: 诶？那就是我们过来的方向，但我们没有看见她呀……

choice:3:0:1.text: Did you see where she went?
choice:3:0:1.male: Did you see where she went?
choice:3:0:1.female: Did you see where she went?

say:0:1013208001:0.text: Fay's keepsake box is here, so she probably didn't venture far.
say:0:1013208001:0.source_cn: 菲小姐的收藏匣就放在这里的话，那她应该没有走远。

say:1:1013208002:0.text: Wow, her notes on gemstone research are quite impressive.
say:1:1013208002:0.source_cn: 这是……宝石研究手记吗？小小年纪，研究得还不错。

say:2:1013208003:0.text: There aren't many clues here; let's revisit where she vanished.
say:2:1013208003:0.source_cn: 营地里似乎没什么线索了，我们去她消失的方向再看看吧。
say:2:1013208003:0.male: There aren't many clues here; let's revisit where she vanished.
say:2:1013208003:0.female: There aren't many clues here; let's revisit where she vanished.

say:0:1013209001:0.text: With so many footprints, it's hard to figure out a direction.
say:0:1013209001:0.source_cn: 附近的脚印过于杂乱，不太好分辨去向。

say:1:1013209002:0.text: However, this shiny object seems intriguing.
say:1:1013209002:0.source_cn: 不过，这个亮闪闪的小玩意儿，似乎有点意思。

say:2:1013209003:0.text: Looks like quartz; maybe it's a marker Fay left along her path.
say:2:1013209003:0.source_cn: 看起来是尖晶石，这会是菲小姐沿途做的标记吗？

say:0:1013210001:0.text: Did Fay really go to this weird village?
say:0:1013210001:0.source_cn: 菲竟然去了这个奇怪的寨子里吗？

say:1:1013210002:0.source_cn: 梅瑞特，这里有什么问题嘛？

say:2:1013210003:0.text: I wanted to negotiate some work with them, but they rejected me!
say:2:1013210003:0.source_cn: 没有……听说是一个商会的地盘，我想跟他们讨点活干，但他...
say:2:1013210003:0.male: I wanted to negotiate some work with them, but they rejected me!
say:2:1013210003:0.female: I wanted to negotiate some work with them, but they rejected me!

say:3:1013210004:0.text: That flag... it's the symbol of the evil Adamant Syndicate!
say:3:1013210004:0.source_cn: 主人，那个旗帜……是坏蛋黑金商会！
say:3:1013210004:0.male: That flag... it's the symbol of the evil Adamant Syndicate!
say:3:1013210004:0.female: That flag... it's the symbol of the evil Adamant Syndicate!

say:0:1013211001:0.text: Unauthorized individuals are prohibited from entering!
say:0:1013211001:0.source_cn: 黑金商会营寨，闲杂人等禁止进入！

say:2:1013211003:0.text: What's the matter, eager to get a taste of my fists?
say:2:1013211003:0.source_cn: 怎么，想尝尝拳头的味道吗？

say:0:1013214001:0.text: There's a girl trapped in a cage up ahead.
say:0:1013214001:0.source_cn: 前面有个女孩被关押在牢笼里。看她的装束，似乎就是我们要...

say:1:1013214002:0.text: Fay! Hang on, we'll get you out of there.
say:1:1013214002:0.source_cn: 菲！稍等一下，我们立刻放你出来——

say:2:1013215002:1.text: Huh? Your scent... no, that scent over there?
say:2:1013215002:1.source_cn: 唔？你的味道……不对，那边的味道才是？

say:4:1013215003:1.text: Hey! Fay, where are you going? Wait up for us!
say:4:1013215003:1.source_cn: 喂！菲，你要去哪？等等我们！

say:1:1013216001:1.text: Oh, sorry. I got so caught up trying to sense the strange gem's aura that I forgot to greet you!
say:1:1013216001:1.source_cn: 啊，不好意思。太过着急确认奇怪宝石的气息，我竟然忘了打招呼！

say:2:1013216002:1.text: I'm Fay, a friend of Marilee's! Did she bring all these new friends here to meet me?
say:2:1013216002:1.source_cn: 我叫菲，是梅瑞特的朋友！梅瑞特带着这么多新朋友，是来找...

say:4:1013216003:2.text: How are you still smiling? You were kidnapped by these bad guys!
say:4:1013216003:2.source_cn: 你居然还笑得出来？你可是被坏人抓走关起来了！

say:5:1013216004:2.text: Huh? They wouldn't kidnap people for no reason; I'm only trapped because I walked into their territory...
say:5:1013216004:2.source_cn: 咦？坏人好端端地为什么要抓走我？我是自己走进这里，才被...

choice_prompt:6:1013216004.text: Huh? They wouldn't kidnap people for no reason; I'm only trapped because I walked into their territory...
choice_prompt:6:1013216004.source_cn: 咦？坏人好端端地为什么要抓走我？我是自己走进这里，才被他们关起来的……

say:7:1013216005:1.text: Because there's a really unique gemstone aura here! I've come across so many gemstones, but I couldn't identify this particular aura... Isn't that intriguing?
say:7:1013216005:1.source_cn: 因为这里有很特别的宝石气息！我遇到过那么多宝石，却无法...
say:7:1013216005:1.male: Because there's a really unique gemstone aura here! I've come across so many gemstones, but I couldn't identify this particular aura... Isn't that intriguing?
say:7:1013216005:1.female: Because there's a really unique gemstone aura here! I've come across so many gemstones, but I couldn't identify this particular aura... Isn't that intriguing?

say:8:1013216006:1.text: I recall you saying your talent lies in sensing gemstones. But I can't believe you put yourself in danger because of that...
say:8:1013216006:1.source_cn: 我记得你说过，你的天赋是感应宝石。会把你引来这种地方，...

say:9:1013216007:1.text: Yeah, sometimes it's a bit troublesome. But don't worry, I'll keep practicing my gemstone magic to protect myself!
say:9:1013216007:1.source_cn: 偶尔是会有点麻烦啦。不用担心，我会持之以恒地修炼宝石魔...

say:10:1013216008:2.text: I... Alright, but you really worried me. I only found you thanks to them.
say:10:1013216008:2.source_cn: 我……还好，倒是也没有很担心。你不知道，今天能找到你，...

say:12:1013216009:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?
say:12:1013216009:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?
say:12:1013216009:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?

choice_prompt:13:1013216009.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?
choice_prompt:13:1013216009.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?
choice_prompt:13:1013216009.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, did you also notice it?

say:14:1013216010:1.text: We've definitely seen some of the items here elsewhere.
say:14:1013216010:1.source_cn: 这里的有些物品，我们不止在一个地方见过。
say:14:1013216010:1.male: We've definitely seen some of the items here elsewhere.
say:14:1013216010:1.female: We've definitely seen some of the items here elsewhere.

say:15:1013216012:1.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's investigate the nearby area.
say:15:1013216012:1.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's investigate the nearby area.
say:15:1013216012:1.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let's investigate the nearby area.

say:16:1013216013:1.text: Though I'm not sure what you're investigating, I have a feeling it's related to gemstones! Let's go take a look!
say:16:1013216013:1.source_cn: 虽然不知道你们在调查什么，但总觉得跟宝石有关系！跟我来...

choice:13:0:1.text: Yes, the aura feels very familiar.
choice:13:0:1.male: Yes, the aura feels very familiar.
choice:13:0:1.female: Yes, the aura feels very familiar.

say:19:1013216011:1.text: Hmm, am I the only one who finds it all familiar? Those "unsellable goods" of the Adamant Syndicate.
say:19:1013216011:1.source_cn: 哼，只有我觉得眼熟吗？黑金商会的“非卖品”。
say:19:1013216011:1.male: Hmm, am I the only one who finds it all familiar? Those "unsellable goods" of the Adamant Syndicate.
say:19:1013216011:1.female: Hmm, am I the only one who finds it all familiar? Those "unsellable goods" of the Adamant Syndicate.

choice:6:0:1.text: Why did you even come here?
choice:6:0:1.male: Why did you even come here?
choice:6:0:1.female: Why did you even come here?

say:0:1013217001:0.text: If I'm not mistaken, this is a golem core.
say:0:1013217001:0.source_cn: 如果我没有猜错的话，这就是魔偶的核心。
say:0:1013217001:0.male: If I'm not mistaken, this is a golem core.
say:0:1013217001:0.female: If I'm not mistaken, this is a golem core.

say:1:1013217002:0.text: The Syndicate is working with the golems? What are they planning?
say:1:1013217002:0.source_cn: 黑金商会和魔偶？他们到底想做些什么呢？
say:1:1013217002:0.male: The Syndicate is working with the golems? What are they planning?
say:1:1013217002:0.female: The Syndicate is working with the golems? What are they planning?

say:2:1013218002:1.text: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!
say:2:1013218002:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特刚刚跟我说您是超级厉害的魔法师，我居然就有幸亲眼...
say:2:1013218002:1.male: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!
say:2:1013218002:1.female: Marilee told me you're an incredibly powerful magister, and I even got to see your magic in action!

say:4:1013218003:1.text: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! He's the most powerful magister in the world!
say:4:1013218003:1.source_cn: 菲小姐，你很有眼光！主人是这个世界上最厉害的魔法师！
say:4:1013218003:1.male: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! He's the most powerful magister in the world!
say:4:1013218003:1.female: Miss Fay, you've got quite an eye! She's the most powerful magister in the world!

say:5:1013218004:1.text: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!
say:5:1013218004:1.source_cn: 没错！您用简简单单的术式就能锁定气息的源头，真了不起！
say:5:1013218004:1.male: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!
say:5:1013218004:1.female: Yep! You can effortlessly pinpoint the source of an aura using simple spells!

say:6:1013218005:1.text: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.
say:6:1013218005:1.source_cn: 要是能早早遇见您，我一定就能通过莱希拉姆的考试了。
say:6:1013218005:1.male: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.
say:6:1013218005:1.female: I would have passed the Lyceum exam if I had met you earlier.

say:8:1013218006:2.text: Your gemstone research is impressive, yet you haven't become a qualified magister yet?
say:8:1013218006:2.source_cn: 你的宝石研究做得还不错，原来还没有取得魔法师的资格吗？

say:9:1013218007:2.text: Ah, I'm not that talented. And those spells and incantations... I really have no idea how to get them into my head.
say:9:1013218007:2.source_cn: 唉，我的天赋不是很强。而且那些术式和咒语……我是真不知...

say:10:1013218008:1.text: I've taken the test three times, and my score has been lower each time...
say:10:1013218008:1.source_cn: 我考了三次，分数一次比一次低……

say:14:1013218010:2.text: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.
say:14:1013218010:2.source_cn: 不好意思，可爱的小姐，你的老师先借我用一下。
say:14:1013218010:2.male: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.
say:14:1013218010:2.female: I'm sorry, Miss, but the magister is needed for a moment.

say:15:1013218011:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come check this out. It's just as you described...
say:15:1013218011:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come check this out. It's just as you described...
say:15:1013218011:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, come check this out. It's just as you described...

say:18:1013218012:1.text: Hmm. These are identical to the damaged core we saw on the golem's head before.
say:18:1013218012:1.source_cn: 嗯。这里的东西，和之前魔偶胸前损坏的核心一模一样。
say:18:1013218012:1.male: Hmm. These are identical to the damaged core we saw on the golem's head before.
say:18:1013218012:1.female: Hmm. These are identical to the damaged core we saw on the golem's head before.

choice_prompt:19:1013218012.source_cn: 嗯。这里的东西，和之前魔偶胸前损坏的核心一模一样。
choice_prompt:19:1013218012.male: Hmm. These are identical to the damaged core we saw on the golem's head before.
choice_prompt:19:1013218012.female: Hmm. These are identical to the damaged core we saw on the golem's head before.

say:20:1013218013:2.text: Are those golems outside related to what's happening here?
say:20:1013218013:2.source_cn: 主人，那外面的魔偶跟这里有关吗？
say:20:1013218013:2.male: Are those golems outside related to what's happening here?
say:20:1013218013:2.female: Are those golems outside related to what's happening here?

say:23:1013218014:1.text: Ohh Chippy's a dummy. So the Adamant Syndicate is controlling the golems!
say:23:1013218014:1.source_cn: 笨蛋满满，主人的意思是坏蛋黑金商会驱动了魔偶！
say:23:1013218014:1.male: Ohh Chippy's a dummy. So the Adamant Syndicate is controlling the golems!
say:23:1013218014:1.female: Ohh Chippy's a dummy. So the Adamant Syndicate is controlling the golems!

choice:19:1:2.source_cn: 门口守卫的态度也很奇怪

say:0:1013219001:0.text: It's not safe here. We should get Fay back to safety first.
say:0:1013219001:0.source_cn: 之后再商讨黑金商会的事情，这里不是很安全，先送菲回去。
say:0:1013219001:0.male: It's not safe here. We should get Fay back to safety first.
say:0:1013219001:0.female: It's not safe here. We should get Fay back to safety first.

say:1:1013219002:0.text: Yeah, the other scholars were really worried about you.
say:1:1013219002:0.source_cn: 是嘞，学会的大家都很担心你。

say:2:1013219003:0.text: I'm sorry... I'll be more careful next time!

say:0:1013220001:0.text: I'm back! Sorry for making everyone worry!
say:0:1013220001:0.source_cn: 我回来啦！我不小心被坏人关起来了……抱歉，让大家替我担心了！

say:1:1013220002:0.text: We're so glad you're safe! We're about to go on a long journey.
say:1:1013220002:0.source_cn: 菲，看到你回来，我们总算放心了。马上要长途跋涉，你要保...

say:2:1013220003:0.text: Long journey? Oh! I also need to rush to the stone tablet site.
say:2:1013220003:0.source_cn: 长途跋涉？差点忘了。我得赶去石刻遗址那边，帮助几位学者...

say:3:1013220004:0.text: Now that Fay's back safe, it's time for me to head home...
say:3:1013220004:0.source_cn: 既然菲被安全找回来，我也差不多该回家了……竟然有点舍不得呢。

say:3:1013221001:1.text: Marilee, though we haven't spent much time together, I've always wanted to be friends with you.
say:3:1013221001:1.source_cn: 梅瑞特，虽然没有太多时间相处，其实我一直想跟你成为朋友。

say:4:1013221002:1.text: Huh? I thought we were already friends. But I hope you won't be stuck in a cage the next time we meet.
say:4:1013221002:1.source_cn: 啊？我还以为我们已经是朋友了。不过，希望下次见面的时候...

say:5:1013221003:1.text: It wasn't on purpose... Next time, I'll definitely improve my gemstone magic and show you my acceptance letter from the Lyceum!
say:5:1013221003:1.source_cn: 我也不是故意的……下次，我一定精进宝石魔法，拿着莱希拉...

say:7:1013221004:1.text: Deal! I won't linger any longer. Goodbye, everyone.
say:7:1013221004:1.source_cn: 一言为定！我就不久留了，各位，再见啦。

choice_prompt:8:1013221004.text: Deal! I won't linger any longer. Goodbye, everyone.
choice_prompt:8:1013221004.source_cn: 一言为定！我就不久留了，各位，再见啦。

say:9:1013221005:1.text: Hope we can meet again soon!
say:9:1013221005:1.source_cn: 你们才是要小心！希望下次很快还能见面！

say:12:1013221007:2.source_cn: 再见，弓箭手梅瑞特小姐！

say:14:1013221006:1.text: No need for thanks. I've learned quite a bit traveling with you all... So, I should be the one saying thanks!
say:14:1013221006:1.source_cn: 哪里的话，与你们同行我学了好几招……我才应该说谢谢！

say:0:1013222001:0.text: Now, we should start gathering information about the golems.
say:0:1013222001:0.source_cn: 现在，应该可以询问魔偶相关的情报了吧。

say:1:1013222002:0.text: ...Do you ever feel like sometimes you lack a bit of empathy?
say:1:1013222002:0.source_cn: ……你有没有觉得，有时你有点没人情味？

say:2:1013222003:0.text: The Temple's code is the only thing that restricts my actions.
say:2:1013222003:0.source_cn: 不好意思。约束我言行的唯有圣堂戒律。

say:1:1013223001:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're interested in information about the golems, right?
say:1:1013223001:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're interested in information about the golems, right?
say:1:1013223001:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, you're interested in information about the golems, right?

say:2:1013223002:1.text: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
say:2:1013223002:1.male: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
say:2:1013223002:1.female: Quick, quick, give me some praise!

choice_prompt:3:1013223002.text: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
choice_prompt:3:1013223002.male: Quick, quick, give me some praise!
choice_prompt:3:1013223002.female: Quick, quick, give me some praise!

say:4:1013223003:1.text: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.
say:4:1013223003:1.source_cn: 当然是因为我善解人意地为大家请来了这里对魔偶最有研究的...
say:4:1013223003:1.male: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.
say:4:1013223003:1.female: Of course, because I brought Mr. John here for you! He's the scholar who has the most knowledge on golems.

say:6:1013223004:2.text: Um... actually, my name is Donn...

say:7:1013223005:1.source_cn: 啊啊，不好意思唐恩先生！

say:8:1013223006:2.text: No worries, I'm used to it. Golem research has always been a niche field... until the recent golem sightings got my attention, and that's when I joined the conservatory.
say:8:1013223006:2.source_cn: 没事，我习惯了。傀儡……不，魔偶研究，一直都是冷门领域...

say:9:1013223007:1.text: So, I'm really happy that you're interested in golems!
say:9:1013223007:1.source_cn: 所以，诸位能对魔偶感兴趣，我真的很开心！

say:11:1013223008:1.text: Wow, he's like a whole different person when talking about his work.

say:12:1013223009:1.text: In ancient times, golems were used by humans to combat Hypofiends. There are even legends that suggest the goddess Dura created these golems...
say:12:1013223009:1.source_cn: 魔偶……不，最初应该叫做傀儡，是上古时期人类对付魔物的...

say:14:1013223010:2.text: Dura above, this is the canon that's always been passed down in the Temple!
say:14:1013223010:2.source_cn: 艾雅在上，这是圣堂一直流传的正典！

say:16:1013223011:2.text: Blessed be Dura. However, what progress has been made in researching why they started to attack humans?
say:16:1013223011:2.source_cn: 感谢艾雅的恩泽。但艾雅创造的傀儡，为什么转而攻击人类，...

say:17:1013223012:1.text: Whether they were created by Dura or humans, they were supposed to stop operating after the war.
say:17:1013223012:1.source_cn: 不管出自艾雅还是上古人类之手，总之战争结束后，一应停止...

say:18:1013223013:1.text: But now they've been reactivated and turned into terrifying golems targeting humans.
say:18:1013223013:1.source_cn: 但现在，傀儡被重新启动，变成了针对人类的可怕魔偶。

say:19:1013223014:1.text: The energy required to give them movement probably isn't simple...
say:19:1013223014:1.source_cn: 能够再次赋予它们行动能力的能源，恐怕不会简单……

choice_prompt:20:1013223014.text: The energy required to give them movement probably isn't simple...
choice_prompt:20:1013223014.source_cn: 能够再次赋予它们行动能力的能源，恐怕不会简单……

say:21:1013223015:1.text: How did this energy fall into the hands of the Adamant Syndicate?
say:21:1013223015:1.source_cn: ……但这种能源，为什么会落到黑金商会手上？

say:22:1013223016:1.text: Can human power really produce such extraordinary things?
say:22:1013223016:1.source_cn: 人的力量……真的能生产出这种出格的东西吗？

say:25:1013223017:2.text: The energy you're talking about, is it those strange gemstones? Mr. Donn, I have an idea...
say:25:1013223017:2.source_cn: 你们说的能源，难道就是那种奇怪的宝石？唐恩先生，我有个...

say:26:1013223018:1.text: If we want to know more about strange gemstones from ancient artifacts...
say:26:1013223018:1.source_cn: 如果是研究古物里的奇怪宝石……

say:27:1013223019:1.text: Could there be people who know more information in the camp at the ruins?
say:27:1013223019:1.source_cn: 遗址那边的营地里，会不会有人了解更多信息？

say:28:1013223020:1.text: That's right. If you want to investigate the golem's energy source, the scholars in that camp might provide some clues.
say:28:1013223020:1.source_cn: 没错，我刚刚想提醒诸位。如果想调查魔偶的能源，那么那片...

say:29:1013223021:2.text: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?
say:29:1013223021:2.source_cn: 刚好，我也要去那片营地！老师，不如我们同时出发，比一比...
say:29:1013223021:2.male: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?
say:29:1013223021:2.female: Great, I'm also heading that way! Shall we go together?

say:30:1013223022:2.text: Wait, Fay... Don't act so impulsively all the time. If you cause trouble again, our hearts won't be able to handle it!
say:30:1013223022:2.source_cn: 等一下，菲……短时间内，你还是不要独自行动了。你要是再...

say:31:1013223023:2.text: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?
say:31:1013223023:2.source_cn: 月神遗殿考古正在最关键的阶段，可不能因为这个影响研究！...
say:31:1013223023:2.male: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?
say:31:1013223023:2.female: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?

choice_prompt:32:1013223023.text: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?
choice_prompt:32:1013223023.source_cn: 月神遗殿考古正在最关键的阶段，可不能因为这个影响研究！魔法师大人，能请你们捎上菲吗？
choice_prompt:32:1013223023.male: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?
choice_prompt:32:1013223023.female: The <style="highlight">Moon Temple</style> excavation is at a critical stage; we can't let this affect the research! Esteemed Magister, could you take Fay with you?

say:33:1013223024:2.text: I'd love to come with you! Please, take me along!!
say:33:1013223024:2.source_cn: 真的可以和老师一起走吗？带上我吧，求求你了！
say:33:1013223024:2.male: I'd love to come with you! Please, take me along!!
say:33:1013223024:2.female: I'd love to come with you! Please, take me along!!

say:34:1013223025:1.text: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!
say:34:1013223025:1.source_cn: 我可以给你宝石当做报酬，只要你路上指点指点我就好了……
say:34:1013223025:1.male: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!
say:34:1013223025:1.female: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!

choice_prompt:35:1013223025.text: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!
choice_prompt:35:1013223025.source_cn: 我可以给你宝石当做报酬，只要你路上指点指点我就好了……
choice_prompt:35:1013223025.male: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!
choice_prompt:35:1013223025.female: I can offer you gemstones as a reward, just guide me on the way!

say:36:1013223026:2.text: So, I can really come? Awesome!
say:36:1013223026:2.source_cn: 那老师就是答应了？好开心！
say:36:1013223026:2.male: So, I can really come? Awesome!
say:36:1013223026:2.female: So, I can really come? Awesome!

say:37:1013223027:1.text: Whew... Finally, I'm about to rid myself of this kid...
say:37:1013223027:1.source_cn: 太好了……终于要把这个可爱的麻烦交出去了……
say:37:1013223027:1.male: Whew... Finally, I'm about to rid myself of this kid...
say:37:1013223027:1.female: Whew... Finally, I'm about to rid myself of this kid...

say:38:1013223028:2.text: You don't mean that, do you? I'm the most well-behaved person ever!
say:38:1013223028:2.source_cn: 可爱的麻烦……难不成是我？唐恩先生，谢谢你说我可爱！

choice:35:0:1.text: You'd better save those for your Lyceum tuition fees.
choice:35:0:1.source_cn: 你还是留着当莱希拉姆的学费吧。
choice:35:0:1.male: You'd better save those for your Lyceum tuition fees.
choice:35:0:1.female: You'd better save those for your Lyceum tuition fees.

choice:20:1:2.source_cn: 和上古技术相当的能源……

say:0:1013224001:0.text: Let's take a quick break before we head out.
say:0:1013224001:0.source_cn: 稍稍休息一下，就要向下一处进发了吗……
say:0:1013224001:0.male: Let's take a quick break before we head out.
say:0:1013224001:0.female: Let's take a quick break before we head out.

say:1:1013224002:0.text: I wanted to have a word with Alya. Can we swing by and talk to her?
say:1:1013224002:0.source_cn: 离开之前，我想跟阿莉雅道个别。能先去她那里吗？
say:1:1013224002:0.male: I wanted to have a word with Alya. Can we swing by and talk to her?
say:1:1013224002:0.female: I wanted to have a word with Alya. Can we swing by and talk to her?

say:0:1013225001:0.text: Fay, I heard you made it back safe and sound. That's a relief.
say:0:1013225001:0.source_cn: 菲，听说你平安归来。我真是松了好大一口气。

say:1:1013226001:3.text: Alya, you've always looked out for me during my time at this camp. I'll really miss you...
say:1:1013226001:3.source_cn: 阿莉雅，我在这个营地的时候，你一直在照顾我……我一定会...

say:2:1013226002:1.text: I hope the research goes smoothly! I know you love the Moon Temple as much as I love gemstones!
say:2:1013226002:1.source_cn: 研究一定要顺顺利利的！我知道，阿莉雅喜欢月神遗殿的程度...

say:3:1013226003:1.text: Same goes for you, I hope you don't get into any trouble on this trip! Everyone, I'm counting on you to look after Fay.
say:3:1013226003:1.source_cn: 你才是，希望这一路上别惹什么麻烦。各位，菲就拜托你们了。

say:5:1013226004:1.text: But speaking of Nakalig and gemstones, I recently heard a legend related to both...
say:5:1013226004:1.source_cn: 不过，说起月神和宝石，最近我倒是听到一个和两者有关的传说……

say:6:1013226005:1.source_cn: 哦？和宝石有关的传说，我要听！

say:7:1013226006:1.text: It goes like this... if you toss a moonstone into the spring at the Moon Temple, you might get enlightenment from the moon god.
say:7:1013226006:1.source_cn: 说是……向月神遗殿的泉眼投入月光石，可能会得到月神的启示。

say:8:1013226007:1.text: Fascinating! The Moon Temple is nearby, can we go check it out?
say:8:1013226007:1.source_cn: 神启？感觉好有趣！老师，月神遗殿就在附近，我们去看看吧！
say:8:1013226007:1.male: Fascinating! The Moon Temple is nearby, can we go check it out?
say:8:1013226007:1.female: Fascinating! The Moon Temple is nearby, can we go check it out?

say:9:1013226008:2.text: The moon god, Nakalig? Impossible. Everyone knows Nakalig has long vanished.
say:9:1013226008:2.source_cn: 月神？不可能。谁都知道，月神早已陨落，艾雅才是唯一真神。

say:10:1013226009:2.text: If I were you, I wouldn't waste precious gemstones!
say:10:1013226009:2.source_cn: 菲，我要是你，就不浪费珍贵的宝石了！

say:12:1013226010:1.text: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?
say:12:1013226010:1.source_cn: 谢谢你，卢修斯大哥！我只是好奇……好奇可是伟大魔法师的...
say:12:1013226010:1.male: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?
say:12:1013226010:1.female: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?

choice_prompt:13:1013226010.text: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?
choice_prompt:13:1013226010.source_cn: 谢谢你，卢修斯大哥！我只是好奇……好奇可是伟大魔法师的天性哦，是吧，老师！
choice_prompt:13:1013226010.male: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?
choice_prompt:13:1013226010.female: I'm just curious, Lucius! Curiosity is the hallmark of a great magister, right?

say:14:1013226011:1.text: The magister didn't object, so that's a yes! Let's go!
say:14:1013226011:1.source_cn: 老师没说反对，就是同意！走吧！
say:14:1013226011:1.male: The magister didn't object, so that's a yes! Let's go!
say:14:1013226011:1.female: The magister didn't object, so that's a yes! Let's go!

say:1:1013227002:0.text: Ahem... Well, it can't hurt to check it out.
say:1:1013227002:0.male: Ahem... Well, it can't hurt to check it out.
say:1:1013227002:0.female: Ahem... Well, it can't hurt to check it out.

say:0:1013228001:0.text: The spring Alya mentioned should be right around here!
say:0:1013228001:0.source_cn: 阿莉雅说的泉眼，应该就在这里！

say:1:1013228002:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me give you a moonstone!
say:1:1013228002:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me give you a moonstone!
say:1:1013228002:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, let me give you a moonstone!

say:2:1013228003:0.text: Careful, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Let's hope no monsters pop up...
say:2:1013228003:0.male: Careful, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Let's hope no monsters pop up...
say:2:1013228003:0.female: Careful, <style="stress"><player_name></style>! Let's hope no monsters pop up...

say:3:1013228004:0.text: Nothing will happen! After all, Nakalig has long disappeared...
say:3:1013228004:0.source_cn: 我觉得什么事都不会发生的！毕竟月神早已陨落……
say:3:1013228004:0.male: Nothing will happen! After all, Nakalig has long disappeared...
say:3:1013228004:0.female: Nothing will happen! After all, Nakalig has long disappeared...

say:0:1013232001:0.text: That glowing spear... Temesia, did you see that?!
say:0:1013232001:0.source_cn: 那发光的长矛——特弥希娅，你看到了吗！

say:1:1013232002:0.text: A fighter who uses a spear... Could it be the Celestial Dionel?
say:1:1013232002:0.source_cn: 投掷长矛作战，还有这样的形貌……难道是半神萨基塔里斯阁下？

say:2:1013233001:1.text: <style="highlight">Archon</style> Dionel... We're truly honored to see Your Excellency here.
say:2:1013233001:1.source_cn: 半神萨基塔里斯大人……竟然能在这里见到您的身姿现世，我...

say:4:1013233002:2.text: Yes! Using the spear to defeat the golems in Holistone and discovering their weakness was also your doing, right?
say:4:1013233002:2.source_cn: 是啊！将长矛投向圣石镇击杀魔偶，并且提示我们魔偶弱点的...

say:7:1013233003:1.text: A Celestial? Sounds impressive, especially with such an elegant presence...
say:7:1013233003:1.source_cn: 半神？听起来很厉害，再加上这优雅的身姿……

say:10:1013233004:2.text: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!
say:10:1013233004:2.source_cn: 不愧是半神大人，好帅！当然在漫漫心中还是主人第一！
say:10:1013233004:2.male: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!
say:10:1013233004:2.female: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!

choice_prompt:11:1013233004.text: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!
choice_prompt:11:1013233004.source_cn: 不愧是半神大人，好帅！当然在漫漫心中还是主人第一！
choice_prompt:11:1013233004.male: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!
choice_prompt:11:1013233004.female: But the magister always comes first in my heart, despite your greatness!

say:13:1013233005:0.text: Even though you interrupted my peaceful rest, I'm not inclined to be angry, rest assured.
say:13:1013233005:0.source_cn: 呵……虽然你们打扰了我宁静的休息时间，不过安心，我没立...

say:14:1013233006:1.text: Moreover, I owe you an apology. After all, these troublesome golems... were once our companions in battles long ago.
say:14:1013233006:1.source_cn: 非但如此，我还要说声不好意思。毕竟，这些给你们带来麻烦...

say:16:1013233007:1.text: Just like what the Evergreen Conservatory described, it seems they do have something to do with the goddess Dura.
say:16:1013233007:1.source_cn: 跟冬青学会说得一样，看来这东西确实跟艾雅女神有关。

say:18:1013233008:1.text: The <style="highlight">Temple Codex</style> tells us that the golems were created by Dura.
say:18:1013233008:1.source_cn: 圣典记录如此，以前的傀儡，现在的魔偶乃是女神的造物。

choice:11:0:1.text: Can you tell me more about golems?
choice:11:0:1.male: Can you tell me more about golems?
choice:11:0:1.female: Can you tell me more about golems?

say:21:1013233009:0.text: I heard you all discussing the legend outside of the Temple. But I'm definitely not the moon god.
say:21:1013233009:0.source_cn: 其实你们在殿外讨论的传说，我都听到了。不过，我确实不是月神。

say:22:1013233010:1.text: But since I received your moonstone, I'll share a few words. Let's consider it your "oracle".
say:22:1013233010:1.source_cn: 但既然收了你们的月光石，无论如何也要说几句话。就当是给...

say:23:1013233011:1.text: Speaking of "oracles"... I've never been a fan of that term.
say:23:1013233011:1.source_cn: 啊，“启示”……我一直不太喜欢这个词。人们将获得“启示...

say:24:1013233012:1.text: People think receiving an "oracle" will somehow accidentally change the course of their lives due to a precious treasure, a kind word, or a single action.
say:24:1013233012:1.source_cn: 坚信自己会因为一件宝物、一句良言、一个行动，无意中改变...

say:25:1013233013:1.text: In reality, every seemingly unintentional action is propelled by destiny. Therefore, your arrival here was inevitable.
say:25:1013233013:1.source_cn: 事实上，世间所谓无意的行动，背后都有着命运的拨弄。因此...

say:26:1013233014:1.text: Now that Merlin's off on his own journey—
say:26:1013233014:1.source_cn: 既然梅林已经踏上了自己的旅途——
say:26:1013233014:1.male: Now that Merlin's off on his own journey—
say:26:1013233014:1.female: Now that Merlin's off on her own journey—

choice_prompt:27:1013233014.text: Now that Merlin's off on his own journey—
choice_prompt:27:1013233014.source_cn: 既然梅林已经踏上了自己的旅途——
choice_prompt:27:1013233014.male: Now that Merlin's off on his own journey—
choice_prompt:27:1013233014.female: Now that Merlin's off on her own journey—

say:28:1013233015:1.text: Congratulations. The road ahead is long, but with the blessing of Dura, your mission is to accomplish what only you can.
say:28:1013233015:1.source_cn: 那么，祝贺你。前路迢迢，但你蒙受艾雅的恩泽，你的使命就...
say:28:1013233015:1.male: Congratulations. The road ahead is long, but with the blessing of Dura, your mission is to accomplish what only you can.
say:28:1013233015:1.female: Congratulations. The road ahead is long, but with the blessing of Dura, your mission is to accomplish what only you can.

say:29:1013233016:2.text: What? He mentioned Merlin—the best title that can be given to a magister?!
say:29:1013233016:2.source_cn: 什、什么！他说梅林——就是那个大魔法师，梅林吗！
say:29:1013233016:2.male: What? He mentioned Merlin—the best title that can be given to a magister?!
say:29:1013233016:2.female: What? He mentioned Merlin—the best title that can be given to a magister?!

say:31:1013233017:0.text: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> actually holds the title of Merlin...?
say:31:1013233017:0.male: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> actually holds the title of Merlin...?
say:31:1013233017:0.female: Hold on, Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style> actually holds the title of Merlin...?

say:34:1013233018:0.text: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> holds that title, then I... I actually have a chance to pass the Lyceum exam!
say:34:1013233018:0.male: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> holds that title, then I... I actually have a chance to pass the Lyceum exam!
say:34:1013233018:0.female: If <style="stress"><player_name></style> holds that title, then I... I actually have a chance to pass the Lyceum exam!

say:37:1013233019:0.text: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I suppose we can't hide this from the others any longer.
say:37:1013233019:0.male: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I suppose we can't hide this from the others any longer.
say:37:1013233019:0.female: Magister <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I suppose we can't hide this from the others any longer.

choice:11:1:2.text: Do you know anything about the legend?
choice:11:1:2.male: Do you know anything about the legend?
choice:11:1:2.female: Do you know anything about the legend?

say:39:1013233020:2.text: Temesia—that is what the others call you, do they not?
say:39:1013233020:2.source_cn: 特弥希娅——我听到他们这么称呼你。

say:41:1013233022:1.text: It's a very charming name. Appropriately so, Dura has also given you... a very precious gift.
say:41:1013233022:1.source_cn: 是个很迷人的名字。与之相称，艾雅也赐予了你……极为珍贵...

say:42:1013233023:1.text: When the time comes, are you prepared to offer your own strength?
say:42:1013233023:1.source_cn: 到了必要的时刻，你要做出奉献自己力量的准备。你有此准备吗？

say:44:1013233025:1.text: You know... how much I long for that day to come.
say:44:1013233025:1.source_cn: 在您的明察面前，我不会说谎。您会知道……我是多么渴望那...

say:45:1013233026:1.text: The only reason I'm still alive is for redemption. If Dura deems I've atoned for my sins and no longer have to bear the hardships of this world... it would only mean liberation for me.
say:45:1013233026:1.source_cn: 我还活着的唯一原因，就是赎罪。如果艾雅判定我已经赎清罪...

say:46:1013233027:1.text: Now, now, put on a smile. Such a beautiful face looks dull when clouded with worry. Moreover, there will soon be a chance for you to atone.
say:46:1013233027:1.source_cn: 那现在，你当微笑。在如此美丽的脸上，愁容是最无聊的表情...

say:48:1013233028:1.text: Chippy doesn't understand what's going on...
say:48:1013233028:1.source_cn: 主人……这位半神大人在说些什么？我怎么听不懂。
say:48:1013233028:1.male: Chippy doesn't understand what's going on...
say:48:1013233028:1.female: Chippy doesn't understand what's going on...

say:50:1013233029:0.text: It's alright, I'm only grasping parts of it too! But Temesia seems really down...
say:50:1013233029:0.source_cn: 没关系，我也听得半懂不懂！但感觉特弥希娅姐姐的样子很悲伤……

say:52:1013233030:1.text: Unfortunately, I can only share this much for now... You're free to leave.
say:52:1013233030:1.source_cn: 很遗憾，现在我能弹奏的篇章仅限于此……诸位也可以离开了。

say:53:1013233031:2.text: Huh? But we didn't get to ask him anything about my precious gemstones!
say:53:1013233031:2.source_cn: 诶诶？半神大人弹奏了吗？

say:55:1013233032:0.text: Miss Fay, you really have a one-track mind...

say:0:1013234001:0.text: Of course one can't keep any secrets from a Celestial...
say:0:1013234001:0.source_cn: 果然。人在半神面前，没有秘密……

say:1:1013234002:0.text: He disappeared as suddenly as he appeared!
say:1:1013234002:0.source_cn: 像突然出现一样，突然消失了！要不要再投入月光石召唤试试？

say:2:1013234003:0.text: Let's go, we shouldn't linger and disturb his peace.
say:2:1013234003:0.source_cn: 我可不建议那样。还是走吧，别不识趣地留在这里打扰半神大...

say:3:1013234004:0.text: Hmm... What do Celestials usually do? Relax in peace?
say:3:1013234004:0.source_cn: 唔……半神大人也会偷懒吗？

say:0:1013235001:0.text: Shame we only saw him for a short while, he seems interesting.
say:0:1013235001:0.source_cn: 可惜只见了一面，好遗憾！看起来是位很有趣的半神大人呢。

say:1:1013235002:0.source_cn: 半神萨基塔里斯的实力，可绝不仅是“有趣”而已……

say:2:1013235003:0.text: Dionel was chosen by Dura to be ascended to a Celestial during the Divine War—
say:2:1013235003:0.source_cn: 在神魔大战中，萨基塔里斯被艾雅选中，升格为半神，致力于...

say:3:1013235004:0.text: So Dionel is definitely a powerhouse!
say:3:1013235004:0.source_cn: 所以说，萨基塔里斯大人是深不可测的强者！

say:4:1013235005:0.text: Divine War? My history's a bit rusty... Wasn't that ages ago?
say:4:1013235005:0.source_cn: 神魔大战？我历史可能不太好……那不是很久之前的事情吗？

say:5:1013235006:0.text: Yes. A long, long time ago...

subtitle:1:1013229003:.text: There seem to be a lot of guests today...
